materials_exhausted.note: Primary XML/OA NXML/PDF text, locator index, supplementary inventory, and linked database packet rows were reopened. The former Table 1 blocker was recoverable from local primary XML/NXML; no blocking local material gap remains for the owner layers.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP/CAMP rows with exact M1 EC50/CC50 values and mucroporin inactivity were reconciled to source locators; DRAMP SARS cell-line wording remains source_conflict, and unsupported fragment SARS/H5N1 rows remain database_only_no_primary_source rather than being smoothed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Table 1 and Results sections were converted into row-level EC50/CC50/SI and qualitative inactivity rows with raw units, targets, assay conditions, replicate notes, and database links.

DBAASP S1/S2 fragment SARS/H5N1 no-activity rows are not supported by the local primary source and remain database_only_no_primary_source.

adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed owner-worker repair recovered Table 1 and Results-section activity/toxicity rows, added explicit target species/cell-line fields, preserved database conflicts, and limited mechanism claims to direct assays with explicit assay provenance. Accepted with cautions for database-only/conflicting external rows.
